[[Zadukar the Blessed]] is a Margonite [[boss]] tasked with holding the [[Bone Palace]]; [[Palawa Joko]] wants his throne back.

==Locations==
*[[The Desolation]]
**{{NPC location|Joko's Domain}} (only during [[A Deal's a Deal]])

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|Aegis}}
*{{skill icon|Dismiss Condition}}
*{{skill icon|Divine Intervention}}
*{{skill icon|Spell Breaker}} ([[elite]])
*{{skill icon|Watchful Healing}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Margonite Mask]]

== Notes ==
*To capture Zadukar's elite skill, the [[party]] must kill Zadukar before the other [[Margonite]]s in his group because once they all die, the quest will trigger a [[cinematic]] that sends the party into the [[Bone Palace]].

== Trivia ==
* The name of this boss is possibly a reference to the [https://wiki.dune2k.com/index.php?title=Sardaukar Sardaukar], a fanatic and ruthless military force from the science fiction series [[w:Dune (franchise)|Dune]] by [[w:Frank Herbert|Frank Herbert]].
